notes.title: Finally Released!!!
notes.content:
TIME FOR RELEASE!!!


We finally released the game!

We appreciate your patience. We've never done this before so there could be some (more) unforeseen problems. We look forward to you finding bugs and us fixing them over the next few weeks :)

We hope you enjoy the game! Let us know what you think on our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/eZeUeW8Z2h
 
And try to leave a review as soon as you can. Steam will promote us more if there are more reviews :)

notes.title: Get Cozy With Corgster In The Wholesome Games Steam Celebration!
notes.content:
We're thrilled bring our NEW story demo to the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration! Take a break from all those human stresses and be a dog for a bit. 

- Play as a corgi on vacation! 
- Use corgi superpowers to glide and climb your way around the island.
- Find cute costumes, toys, and cozy spots hidden everywhere.
- Help people with their problems, just like dogs do! 
- Prove stubby legs won't stop you!

We are a two-person team making games that donate to animal shelters. Thanks to our mobile game players, we've donated over $15,000 to animal shelters. For A Corgi's Cozy Hike, we will donate 10% of everything we make from it. 

Our new demo a bite-sized look at the adorable story in A Corgi's Cozy Hike.

You can follow our company page on Steam, Scalisco to learn when we make new games that donate to shelters and other causes.

notes.title: Our Kickstarter IS LIVE!
notes.content:
https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0624/9414/6786/files/kickstarter_banner_w_project_we_love_badge.png?v=1681298886

Kickstarter IS LIVE!

Attention all gamers and pet lovers! We have some exciting news to share with you! A Corgi's Cozy Hike's Kickstarter is live and ready for pledges!!!

By pledging early, you'll make sure you have access to our limited rewards, which include the opportunity to have your beloved dog (or cat, bird, or any other pet) featured in our game. Imagine seeing your furry friend running around in a video game? What about their picture in our credits? Or immortalized as a statue for all our players to see forever? It's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that you don't want to miss! 

Back our project now! You can always change or cancel your pledge later, so no reason to hesitate. Your early support helps us gain visibility.

Thank you for your support! We're working hard to bring you the best game we can. Join Our Mission and don't forget to Love Like A Dog.

Wishing you the Best,
- Dan Scalise

notes.title: Kickstarter marked our project a "Project We Love!"
notes.content:
https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0624/9414/6786/files/kickstarter_banner_w_project_we_love_badge.png?v=1681298886

Kickstarter - "Project We Love"

Attention all gamers and pet lovers! We have some exciting news to share with you! A Corgi's Cozy Hike's project has been recognized by Kickstarter as a "Project We Love", which proves we're on the right track to creating something truly special.

By pledging early, you'll make sure you have access to our early bird and limited rewards, which include the opportunity to have your beloved dog (or cat, bird, or any other pet) featured in our game. Imagine seeing your furry friend running around in a video game? What about their picture in our credits? Or immortalized as a statue for all our players to see forever? It's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that you don't want to miss! Press that  Notified Me button now!

Our Mission

https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0624/9414/6786/files/amount_of_dogs_helped_a9069143-4686-42f7-9bbb-33d49502c6ac.png?v=1680856005

Our mission is all about bringing together two passions - gaming and pets. We've donated over $15,000 to rescue more than 30 dogs thanks to our mobile game players and customers. 

With A Corgi's Cozy Hike, we're on our way to crushing those numbers, but to make this game a reality, we need your support. Please go to our website and Join Our Mission. You'll see the puppy parties we've sponsored and all the adorable dogs that our games have helped.

Press B to Bark!

https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0624/9414/6786/files/Corgi_Glide_to_Cliff_and_Climb_-_Gif_-_8s_-_Crop_-_8MB.gif?v=1681506791

Yes, we've added barking as a feature! We hope you join our Discord so you can bark while you wait. We're building a wholesome community of dog lovers and have the best surprises in store for you there. 

Thank you for your support! We're working hard to bring you the best game we can. Join Our Mission and don't forget to Love Like A Dog.

Wishing you the Best,
- Dan Scalise
